provenance.sha_source: GitHub contents API — this is UPSTREAM'S OWN git blob identifier for those bytes. It is deliberately NOT a digest we computed over what we wrote: a self-computed hash proves only that we hashed our own bytes, so a mistaken or malicious edit that updated both the file and the digest would pass.

notes: The vendored file is UPSTREAM BYTES AND NOTHING ELSE. It carries no local header, no lint suppression and no formatting pass, because any of those would break the byte-identity that upstream_blob_sha asserts. Provenance lives here, in this sibling file, for exactly that reason.

COUPLING NOTE for whoever takes the deferred elek version move (EHAC-2103 / D-04): bumping selimozten/elek in .github/workflows/ai-code-review.yml invalidates FOUR things at once, and they must move in one change — (1) this manifest's upstream_commit and upstream_blob_sha, plus a re-fetch of the vendored file; (2) ELEK_REF_VERIFIED, which is re-exported from this manifest by elek-prompt-budget.mjs and asserted against the workflow pin; (3) every file under fixtures/golden/, which is frozen at this pin and must be regenerated by generate-goldens.mjs; (4) the pr-3515.diff truncation proof in coverage-gate-tests.yml — a newer packer may stop truncating that fixture, at which point the non-vacuity step would pass for the wrong reason. Check (4) by hand; the other three are asserted.

STATED LIMITATION: none of the offline assertions in elek-prompt-budget.test.mjs proves that the GitHub Action executing at runtime uses these semantics. The only link is upstream_commit equalling the workflow's action pin, and that is a link by COMMIT IDENTITY, not by execution. It is written here rather than implied away.
